$comment: Bundled defaults for shell verbs the approval gate auto-allows when invoked inside an audience-aware safe space (session_dir + project_dir for Personal/Team; session_dir only for Public). Each entry is a verb chain matched by exact equality against ShellTokenizer.ExtractVerbChain output. Mutating verbs are intentionally absent — git push, awk -i inplace, sed -i etc. still prompt. sed is pinned to its read-only -n flag form. Users may extend this list at ~/.netclaw/config/safe-verbs.linux.json (additive merge).
